## You must change `src/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [src/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at
least one changed file falls under it. Writing tests, documentation or a report

## Evidence — verified finding

```
The session runs one engine and cannot meet the other: `run_program` at src/repl/mod.rs:443-451 calls `self.vm.run(program)` unconditionally, and no `BytecodeVm`, engine flag, or toggle exists anywhere in src/repl/ (verified by grep) — although the language ships two engines and phase-066's `.compare` will prove they can disagree. Both Ipp (`.vm interpreter/vm`, shown in the banner with a switch hint) and inscript (`.vm` toggle) treat engine choice as session state, because `which engine am I talking to` is the first question behind every behavioral surprise.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Add `.vm [walker|bytecode]` showing the current engine or switching it, with the banner and prompt naming the engine at all times. Bindings survive the switch (both engines read the same session state); history and last-result are engine-independent and untouched. The default stays the tree-walker: the documented language semantics.

## Definition of done

- [ ] `.vm` with no argument names the current engine; `.vm bytecode` then `say 1+1` prints `3` through the bytecode VM (proved by an engine-marker in a test hook, not by trusting the prompt text)
- [ ] bindings survive both directions (`set x to 9`, switch, `say x` prints `9`, switch back, still `9` — asserted on values, so state is shared and never re-seeded)
- [ ] an engine-specific divergence is reported with the engine named (seeded from a differential-corpus edge both engines treat differently, so the test cannot pass on one engine twice)
- [ ] `.vm` with a third engine name is refused listing the two valid ones; the prompt shows the engine after every switch without needing `:help` to confirm
- [ ] edge_* tests cover switching mid-multiline-block (block preserved, engine applies at execution), `.vm` inside a `:save`d session (engine choice persists through save/restore), and rapid double-switch (idempotent, session identical)
